variant: factory crawler excavator with the Real-X autonomy system and Gravis rack
name: Develon Real-X autonomous crawler excavator (DX225LC-7X)
summary: A Develon DX225LC-7X crawler excavator sold with the Real-X system, developed with Gravis Robotics, that digs trenches, does earthworks and loads trucks on its own under a technical supervisor. The first unit went into use at KIBAG in Switzerland in June 2026.

germany.statusNote: The only documented sale is in Switzerland: the Swiss Develon dealer AG für Baumaschinen Schmerikon handed the first Real-X DX225LC-7X to KIBAG in June 2026, with Develon's key account manager for German-speaking countries present. No offer, price or customer in Germany or the EU was found. The Gravis Rack retrofit kit used in Real-X has its own record (gravis-robotics-gravis-rack, on quote).

specs.label: Base machine
specs.quote: The key players here are the AI-powered Real-X system on a Develon DX225LC-7X excavator

specs.label: Autonomous tasks
specs.value: trench excavation, earthworks and truck loading
specs.quote: At bauma 2025, Develon introduced Real-X, an intelligent crawler excavator designed to carry out trench excavation, earthworks and truck loading autonomously.

specs.label: Claimed performance gain
specs.conditions: maker claim for trench excavation, earthworks and truck loading
specs.quote: Develon said the technology could help address skills shortages in construction, while offering a 30% performance improvement in trench excavation, earthworks and truck loading.

specs.label: Supervision
specs.value: autonomous on private land under a technical supervisor; no operator in the cab and no remote control
specs.quote: the machine can be operated autonomously on KIBAG’s private land, supervised by a technical supervisor

specs.label: Autonomy partner
specs.quote: Real-X is the result of an agreement between HD XiteSolution, the holding company of Develon, and Gravis Robotics.

notes: A complete excavator with bucket, not a retrofit kit; the autonomy hardware is the Gravis rack.
Rules for autonomous machines in public spaces are not yet clear; KIBAG runs it on its own land.
Shown to about 900 dealers, customers and journalists at the Develon Demo Days in the Czech Republic in April 2026.

evidence.task: Digs a trench 300 m long, 6 m wide and 3 m deep without an operator in the cab, on a former quarry being restored
evidence.where: Tuggen, canton of Schwyz, Switzerland – KIBAG
evidence.note: First Real-X sold; delivered by the Swiss Develon dealer AGFBS. The trench is filled with rock to stop the foot of the hill slipping.

evidence.task: Autonomous excavator demonstrated to dealers, customers and trade journalists
